FWindowsViewport::ApplyGameSettings (2012 0x60aa40, unnamed in 2013). The only part of the settings republish that persists anything without a Steam client: for ASLI_ValidatedByUser it resizes the viewport when the resolution, fullscreen or vsync differ, and FWindowsViewport::Resize ends in GSystemSettings.SetResolution, which writes ResX/ResY/bFullscreen to GEngineIni. It also writes GSystemSettings TextureForcedLODBias (+128), SkeletalLODDistanceFactorMultiplier (+120), bAllowLightShafts (+76) and bAllowRatsShadow (+80). DEVIATION: retail's 2013 Resize takes the vsync flag as a parameter and this tree's does not, so the flag is put into GSystemSettings directly; and retail passes its own stored window position where this passes the -1/-1 default
